# Edusphere Academy — Full Course & Organisation Details

> Edusphere Academy Pte Ltd is a skills training academy located at 26 Jalan Camar 1, Taman Perling, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia. We offer hands-on, part-time certificate courses in healthcare support, caregiving, hospital administration, and barista arts. All courses run on weekends (36 hours over 12 weeks) and cost MYR 1,500 total. Open Monday–Sunday, 9am–6pm.

## Contact & Location

- Website: https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my
- Email: info@edusphereacademy.com.my
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 17-755 8196
- Address: 26 Jalan Camar 1, Taman Perling, 81200 Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=26%20Jalan%20Camar%201%2C%20Taman%20Perling%2C%2081200%20Johor%20Bahru%2C%20Johor%2C%20Malaysia
- Operating hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00am–6:00pm

## Entry Requirements (all courses)

- Minimum age: 16 years old
- N Level or equivalent recommended
- No prior experience required
- Final admission decided by the Academic Advisory Board

## Fee Structure (all courses)

- Registration fee: MYR 100 (non-refundable)
- Monthly fee: MYR 500 x 3 months
- Total: MYR 1,500

## Refund Policy

- More than 30 days before commencement: 100% refund
- Before, but not more than 30 days before commencement: 50% refund
- After, but not more than 15 days after commencement: 25% refund
- More than 1 day after commencement: 0% refund

---

## Course 1: Advanced Certificate in Nursing Aide

**URL:** https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/advanced-certificate-in-nursing-aide

A 36-hour part-time programme combining classroom learning with hands-on practical training in first aid & CPR/AED, wound care support, and physiotherapy support skills — preparing students for healthcare support roles in hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centres, and home care settings.

### Modules
1. **First Aid + CPR/AED** (12 hours) — Emergency response, injury management, CPR & AED skills with 2-year valid certification
2. **Wound Care Support & Management** (12 hours) — Wound care, infection prevention, dressing assistance, pressure injury prevention
3. **Physiotherapy Support Skills** (12 hours) — Mobility & transfer techniques, exercise assistance, rehabilitation support

### Key Skills Taught
- First aid and emergency response
- CPR and AED skills
- Wound care support and management
- Physiotherapy support skills
- Infection prevention and control
- Safe patient handling and mobility

### Career Paths
Nursing Aide, Healthcare Assistant, Patient Care Assistant, Home Care Aide, Rehabilitation Support Assistant, Community Care Assistant

---

## Course 2: Advanced Certificate in Professional Caregiving (Elderly, Autism & Child Care)

**URL:** https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/advanced-certificate-in-professional-caregiving

A 36-hour part-time caregiving programme covering three high-demand specialisations — elderly care, autism care, and child care — with hands-on, person-centred training for home, community, and institutional care settings.

### Modules
1. **Elderly Caregiving** (12 hours) — Ageing process, ADL support, fall prevention, dementia awareness
2. **Autism & Special Needs Care** (12 hours) — Autism spectrum understanding, communication strategies, behavioural support
3. **Child Care** (12 hours) — Child development, nutrition, safety, play-based learning

### Key Skills Taught
- Elderly caregiving
- Autism care support
- Child care
- Person-centred care
- Daily living assistance

### Career Paths
Professional Caregiver, Elderly Care Assistant, Special Needs Support Aide, Childcare Support Assistant

---

## Course 3: Advanced Certificate in Hospital & Healthcare Administration

**URL:** https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/hospital-healthcare-administration

A 36-hour, industry-focused programme building practical skills in healthcare operations, patient administration, medical records, healthcare IT systems, and customer service excellence for administrative roles in hospitals, clinics, and healthcare organisations.

### Modules
1. **Healthcare Operations & Service Excellence** (12 hours) — Healthcare systems, patient flow, quality assurance
2. **Patient Administration & Medical Records** (12 hours) — Registration, documentation, data privacy, records management
3. **Healthcare IT & Digital Systems** (12 hours) — HIS, EMR, clinic management software

### Key Skills Taught
- Healthcare operations
- Patient administration
- Medical records management
- Healthcare IT systems
- Customer service excellence

### Career Paths
Hospital Administrative Assistant, Patient Service Coordinator, Clinic Front Office Executive, Healthcare Operations Staff

---

## Course 4: Certificate in Barista Arts

**URL:** https://www.edusphereacademy.com.my/courses/barista-arts

A 36-hour part-time barista training programme covering espresso extraction, milk texturing, latte art, and cafe service — preparing students for barista and cafe roles in coffee chains, hotels, and specialty coffee establishments.

### Modules
1. **Espresso Fundamentals** (12 hours) — Coffee origins, roasting, grind calibration, shot pulling
2. **Milk Texturing & Latte Art** (12 hours) — Steaming, pouring techniques, hearts, rosettas, tulips
3. **Cafe Service & Workflow** (12 hours) — Menu execution, workflow, hygiene, customer service

### Key Skills Taught
- Espresso extraction
- Milk texturing
- Latte art
- Cafe service and workflow
- Coffee fundamentals

### Career Paths
Barista, Cafe Service Crew, Coffee Specialist
